subject: pathology
title: Lobar Pneumonia Stages, Tuberculosis Complexes, Miliary TB, Aspergilloma, and Pneumocystis

steps.tx: Lobar pneumonia consolidates an entire lobe through congestion, red hepatisation of exudate and red cells, grey hepatisation of fibrin and neutrophils, then enzymatic resolution, classically from pneumococcus. That four act sequence is **lobar pneumonia pathological stages**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Congestion, red hepatisation, grey hepatisation, resolution: lobar pneumonia performs in four classic acts.

rows: Firm red, red cells and fibrin

steps.tx: Bronchopneumonia patches patchy consolidation around bronchioles in infants, elderly, and debilitated patients from staphylococci, streptococci, and gram negatives, unlike lobar disease's single lobe drama. The patchy pattern is **bronchopneumonia of the vulnerable host**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Patchy peribronchiolar consolidation in the very young or old is bronchopneumonia, not lobar disease.

steps.tx: Atypical pneumonia inflames interstitium more than airspaces with mycoplasma, viruses, chlamydia, and legionella, producing dry cough and infiltrates out of proportion to sparse chest signs. The interstitial pattern is **atypical (interstitial) pneumonia**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Dry cough, scanty signs, striking film: atypical pneumonia lives in interstitium, not alveoli.

vis.caption: Pneumonia imaging patterns across aspiration and consolidation syndromes.

steps.tx: Primary tuberculosis implants a subpleural Ghon focus with draining hilar nodes as Ghon complex in children, usually calcifying into Ranke complex while viable bacilli may sleep for decades. That childhood imprint is the **Ghon and Ranke complex of primary tuberculosis**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Ghon focus plus its node makes the complex; calcified Ranke complex is its tombstone with sleeping tenants.

nodes.label: Ghon focus plus hilar node complex
Ranke complex, latent bacilli may persist

steps.tx: Secondary tuberculosis reactivates at oxygen rich apices as Assmann foci, cavitating, spreading bronchogenically and by cough to contacts, while Simon foci mark early haematogenous apical seeding. Apical cavitation defines **secondary (reactivation) pulmonary tuberculosis**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Apical cavities coughing bacilli are secondary tuberculosis; oxygen rich apices wake sleeping disease.

steps.tx: Miliary tuberculosis showers millet seed granulomas through lungs, liver, spleen, and meninges when bacilli disseminate haematogenously in infants or immunocompromised hosts, demanding lumbar and fundal examination. The millet shower is **miliary disseminated tuberculosis**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Millet seeds on imaging plus choroid tubercles in the eye spell miliary tuberculosis; treat on sight.

vis.caption: Miliary tuberculosis dissemination with millet seed granulomas across organs.

steps.tx: Aspergilloma balls fungus inside old tuberculous cavities without invading tissue in immunocompetent hosts, declaring through haemoptysis that may turn catastrophic, imaged with mobile intracavitary mass and air crescent. The saprophytic ball is **aspergilloma (fungus ball) in old cavities**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: A mobile ball in an old TB cavity with haemoptysis is aspergilloma; invasion is not its style.

steps.tx: Pneumocystis pneumonia frosts alveoli with foamy eosinophilic exudate and cup shaped organisms on silver stain in advanced HIV, producing hypoxaemia out of proportion to imaging whispers. The AIDS defining pneumonia is **Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (PCP)**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Foamy alveolar casts and silver stained cups in advanced HIV mean Pneumocystis pneumonia.

vis.caption: Pneumocystis pneumonia histology with foamy alveolar exudate and cup organisms.
